title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A scalable full-stack e-commerce platform built with React, Node.js, and AWS services. Features include product catalog, shopping cart, payment processing, and admin dashboard with real-time analytics.

title: Real-Time Chat Application
description: A real-time messaging app with WebSocket connections, user authentication, and message persistence. Built for scalability with Redis pub/sub and horizontal scaling capabilities.

title: Data Pipeline ETL System
description: An automated data pipeline for processing large datasets using AWS Lambda, S3, and Glue. Processes 10TB+ monthly with built-in monitoring and error handling.
